# cb:b304 · contradictions-must-be-expensive

> Contradictions in the governance substrate must be expensive to introduce - if contradictions are free, agent behavior drifts silently as competing rules accumulate and no mechanism surfaces the tension

**Type:** prescription · **Kind:** design-principle · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `conflicts`
**Created:** 2026-04-12

**Artifact:** `plan:cb-schema-v2`

## Evidence

1. **2026-04-12** - Before Phase 4, nothing detected when two policies stated opposing things. An agent followed whichever rule it read first. The audit mechanism exists to make scope-overlapping policies visible so contradictions require explicit resolution rather than accumulating quietly.
   - artifact: [`document:policy`](../../../policy)
